messages:
maria.v: Heads up — ran the int8 concurrency sweep on rdx-2b-v1 this morning and seeing intermittent p95 spikes around 200-500 conc. bf16 baseline is stable.

ajay.k: Ugh, saw one of those too on my run. p50 stays fine, but p95 jumps ~3x for short windows. Any error logs?

maria.v: Logs attached (short excerpt). pattern: CPU waiting, then large inference queue.
```
[2025-11-03T09:12:34Z] runner: recv req conn=12 seq=345 latency=2.1ms
[2025-11-03T09:12:34Z] kv-cache: prefetch key=0x7f4a size=64 status=miss src=runner
[2025-11-03T09:12:34Z] runner: enqueue batch size=1 wait=18ms
[2025-11-03T09:12:34Z] quant: fallback path=naive-dequant
```

sylvie: That kv prefetch line stands out. Could be double prefetch on concurrent requests causing lock contention in the cache layer.

leo: Did you run with the new prefetch gating flag? `--kv-prefetch=auto` vs `--kv-prefetch=disabled` makes a difference in small repros.

maria.v: I ran default (auto). I'll try `--kv-prefetch=disabled` next. Also used the usual harness command:
```
./eval-runner --model rdx-2b-v1 --quant int8 --concurrency 256 --duration 15m --workload=prompt-short
```

ajay.k: A few other notes: the CI job `test/eval-load/quant-sweeps` recently started running parallel shards on the same runner host (to save infra). That can surface resource contention that doesn't happen in dedicated runs.

ci-bot: Jenkins job #4821 finished: 3 shards ran, 1 flaky failure (p95 spike). Link: https://ci.internal/4821

maria.v: Good catch. My local runs were on a shared perf pool node. I'll re-run on an isolated node and with `--warmup=60s --ramp=30s`.

sylvie: Also please capture the workload histogram and the batch distribution. In past cases a sudden shift to single-item batches during rollover caused p95 to jump. Query to get batch size distribution: `sum(rate(batch_size_count[1m])) by (size)` in prometheus.

leo: If it's kv prefetch + quant path, we should also verify the quantized kernel selection doesn't force a slower codepath. Try `KV_PREFETCH=0 RUNTIME_TRACE=1 ./eval-runner ...` to get kernel tags.

maria.v: Plan for next 12h: 1) re-run on isolated node w/ kv-prefetch disabled, warmup/ramp. 2) run with runtime trace to collect kernel tags. 3) upload batch-size histogram + runner logs to the eval bucket. I'll post results here.

eval-bot: New trace created: gs://eval-traces/1795004321/run-20251103-0914.tar.gz

ajay.k: If this repros only under shared hosts, we should change CI to not co-locate quant-sweep shards on the same runner host. I'll open a tiny PR to the Jenkins job config.

sylvie: Also let's add a deterministic-seed flag to the harness so CI runs are more comparable (randomized padding was causing minor variance). `--deterministic-seed=1234`

maria.v: Results so far: isolated run with kv-prefetch disabled removed the spike. re-enabled prefetch and reproduced the spike again. So looks like a prefetch contention issue interacting with quant kernels. Uploading traces now.

leo: Nice repro. Next steps: 1) triage kv cache locks (sylvie), 2) check quant kernel fallback conditions (leo), 3) make CI change to run shards isolated (ajay).

maria.v: I'll open an issue with attached traces and tag you all. Thanks! :thumbsup:
